install_hint: see goose docs (block/goose) — brew install block-goose-cli or install script
note: Goose headless via `goose run -t`. ⚠ goose executes tool actions (can edit files/run commands) — point it at a repo you can diff.
Plandex `tell` plans into its own sandbox; nothing touches your files until you run `plandex apply` yourself.
Amp execute mode (-x). ⚠ agentic — can act on the workspace; review its changes.
Crush non-interactive single prompt via `crush run`.

install_hint: see AWS docs — Amazon Q Developer CLI (`q`)
note: Q chat headless; --trust-no-tools keeps it read-only (no tool execution).
